scores.tell: Whole card is mid-to-bright blue with busy water caustics; the white goal and orange ball separate only weakly, and no dark accents anchor the hero.
Bright, saturated key with a few darker accents (wood posts, shadows under the stools). The scene is busy, so there is no clear hero or value hierarchy.
Light blue orb against mid-green, and the dark wood table anchors the bottom. Value grouping is clear and close to the real cards. The diamond pattern is slightly busy.
Bright, saturated key. The orange background and blue hero are separated by hue more than by value. Shadows are soft and there is no vignette.
Light green cactus on a pale blue background with warm sand below. Gentle local contrast and clean groups. The hero and background are close in value.
None. Red and silver rocket against a bright cyan burst. Dark accents are small (nozzle, window rims) and the hero separates by both hue and value, like the real cards.
Brightness is uniform across the whole scene. The bright sky and water and the pale sand reduce hero separation. It lacks a focal value pop.
A dark grey floor takes a large area and the console is a mid-teal. The dark floor is heavier than in the real cards, but the hero separates well.
Orange and white rover against a bright green burst. The dark tires give strong accents, a bit heavier than real. The groups are readable.
The saturated pink and magenta coral on a green background are close in value. The dark grey rocks are a large dark mass at the bottom, and the hero's value separation is weak.
